title: ?旗房
subtitle: outside the walls

model.line: On the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class, its form drawn by the hall kit. It will be updated as the research goes on.
rows: platform 0.45 m, eave 3.2 m, ridge 5.25 m above the ground
gable 硬山 or 悬山, rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile

by the hall kit: 3 bays, the middle widest, a porch front, steps on the front, 硬山 flush gable with a rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile, a painted beam under the eave. Drawn from the typology of its hall class, not from a picture of this hall (assumed, C).

evidence.title: 内务府 工程 乾隆三十六年 复查 (as quoted in S220)
evidence.locator: S220 section 三; archive not seen
evidence.excerpt_zh: 绮春园添建宫门、朝房、诸旗房间，并周围添砌虎石大墙，园内龙王庙添建涵洞……清理地面等项工程。
evidence.summary: New gate, offices and guard rooms of the banners after the garden became imperial. S220 glosses the 龙王庙 as in the later 延英论道 area, agreeing with S47. The 诸旗房间 fits the plan's guard house ?旗房 Z-QN07 by name only; this gate is an earlier one, so a guess.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled ?旗房 (? marks an unread character), 3x1 cells.
